packaged_qualification.linux_result: Passed: 267 Rust tests matched source names/count; 18 Python tests; formatting, strict Clippy, documentation tests, release builds, packaged URL fixtures and desktop launch.
packaged_qualification.windows_and_final_release: The publisher requires both platform jobs and bundled-url-intake-and-parallel-downloads to pass for the exact release commit. Final receipts include archive hashes and source trees.

retained_release_failure.result: Linux passed. Windows stopped before packaging when the cancellation test's PowerShell child did not signal readiness within ten seconds. Publication was skipped.
retained_release_failure.correction: Use the native Rust test executable for both parent and descendant fixtures. Check normal completion first, capture startup diagnostics, and allow the descendant's attempted write only after cancellation returns. The application process-management code is unchanged.
